subject: Ethics Commission and Financial Reporting
overview: The Ethics Reporting Subcommittee agreed on charter parameters for establishing a five-member ethics commission and annual financial disclosure requirements. The proposed structure will be submitted to the Collins Center to draft charter language before going to the full committee.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the previous subcommittee meeting.

items.title: Ethics Commission Structure and Financial Reporting Requirements
items.summary: Agreed on parameters for a five-member, uncompensated Ethics Commission tasked with administering an annual financial disclosure form for elected officials and key administrators due March 1st. The subcommittee set appointments at two by the mayor, two by the City Council, and one by the School Committee, with language to be drafted by the Collins Center.
